And the currently-running anwendung process — I need to confirm it's the one from the latest successful startup.

The HTTP evidence is decisive: `/xplan-manager-web/` returns 200 with title "XPlanManagerWeb". So the current manager-web IS running and serving. The 12:13 SEVERE is a past failed startup that was superseded.

import re
d=open('/tmp/wmscaps.xml').read()
# leaf layers are <Layer> without nested <Layer>
# crude: collect all Names
names=re.findall(r'<Name>([^<]+)</Name>',d)
# print unique non-group candidates
seen=[]
for n in names:
    if n not in seen: seen.append(n)
print(seen[:25])
